name: North Pacific Current
scope: NOAA glossary regional extent from about 160 degrees E to an OSW gate at 145 degrees W, somewhat beyond the source's approximate 150 degrees W region. Alternative ends at 150 degrees W. This convention excludes downstream Alaska/California branches and the Kuroshio Extension. It is not the entire Japan-to-North-America circulation or a universal naming extent; AMS describes a different western origin near 170 degrees W.
layer: Upper-ocean regional reference geography; no depth-specific velocity axis extracted.
time_convention: Undated glossary-convention sketch; no simultaneous or climatological current axis inferred.
source_locator: North Pacific Current entry: eastward flow from approximately 160 degrees E to beyond approximately 150 degrees W, continuing Kuroshio Extension and branching south. Kuroshio Extension entry separates the preceding component.
source_citation: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services, Tides and Currents Glossary, North Pacific Current entry (accessed 2026-10-02).
source_license: Factual geography only; no provider curves, map imagery or velocity field packaged.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects all latitudes, intermediate vertices and the 145 degrees W terminal gate. NOAA's glossary supplies broad longitudinal limits and identity, not these coordinates or a measured flow axis. Three broad latitude conventions and two eastern gates expose some of that underdetermination.

alternative_routes.interpretation: OSW southern latitude convention; not a source-diagnosed current axis.

scenario_rule: Six corridor/gate combinations, three uniform longitude shifts (-0.5/0/+0.5 degrees) and independent endpoint latitude shifts (-0.5/0/+0.5 degrees): 162 editorial scenarios. These ranges are assumptions, not empirical positional errors.
remaining_gates: Independent review of NOAA versus other naming conventions and current identity across the latitude corridors.

Canonical admission and publication review; preserve date-line policy and scope.

supporting_sources.citation: American Meteorological Society, Glossary of Meteorology, North Pacific Current entry.
supporting_sources.locator: Opening definition: northern subtropical-gyre limb, origin near 170 degrees W and mixing with Aleutian flow.
supporting_sources.role: Contrasting naming convention; not used to silently extend or redefine this NOAA-convention candidate.

method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed. Explicit date-line policy: longitude-normalized scenario vertices, continuously unwrapped geodesic display, and periodic land/state/crop joins.
map_land_check: All 162 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
